laws.rule: Aargau's hospitality law (Gesetz über das Gastgewerbe und den Kleinhandel mit alkoholhaltigen Getränken, § 4): restaurants and bars must stay closed Monday to Friday from 00:15 to 05:00, on Saturday from 02:00 to 05:00, and on Sundays and public holidays from 02:00 to 07:00. On Good Friday, Easter Sunday, Whit Sunday, the Federal Day of Thanksgiving, Repentance and Prayer, Christmas Day and the following day, they must close at 00:15. Hotel guests may be served at any time. The municipal council may, under planning and environmental law, extend or shorten a venue's hours, allow a later close for a particular event, or set general late-opening nights for local events (§ 4(3bis)). A breach of the Act or of orders made under it is a fine of up to CHF 10,000 (about A$17,274); the municipal council may issue a penalty order of up to CHF 2,000 (about A$3,455) (§§ 13 and 14).
